youtube.baslik: Can one ear hear with both an implant and acoustic sound? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In electric-acoustic stimulation (EAS), the high frequencies are stimulated electrically by the implant and the low frequencies acoustically with amplified sound; the candidate has usable low-frequency hearing but a severe to profound loss in the high frequencies. The point where the two regions meet is called the crossover frequency and is chosen from the person's audiogram; today, in many systems the same processor delivers both the implant stimulation and acoustic sound.
